ValidationRule.description: This validation rules restricts the Stage updates on opportunities related to Prospect Accounts
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
IF( AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), ISCHANGED(StageName), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PMC_SS_Prospect', NOT( ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Indirect Sales') ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Proposal'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Finalize Quote'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won') )
), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Prospect Accounts are not eligible for the stage you’re selecting. Please start the Credit Check Process to convert this account to a Customer Account
